content: Protocol drift is the top failure mode for unofficial WhatsApp clients. Concrete evidence: Baileys pins the WA Web version at publish time and WhatsApp rejects stale pins with connection failure status 405 before a QR is ever issued (fixed by resolving the live version from web.whatsapp.com at connect time with ~6h cache and clearing cache on 405). whatsapp-web-reveng notes the version's last value changes frequently. Other drift examples: whatsmeow #705 view-once messages broke after a WA update; #1197 'Unable to send message to new contact after July 2nd update'; Baileys #2248 companion protocol handling changes causing immediate 401 device_removed. Prevention: never hard-pin protocol version; resolve at runtime, fail soft with clear diagnostics, maintain protobuf compatibility and monitor upstream whatsmeow/Baileys issue trackers for drift signals.
